ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent pipeline for satellite collision avoidance, processing live TLE data and simulating orbital maneuvers to generate verified collision-avoidance telemetry.
ideas.title: OrbitalDebris-AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a critical real-world aerospace problem and mimics the autonomous incident response pattern seen in previous hackathon winners.

ideas.pitch: Real-time telemetry anomaly detection dashboard for sounding rockets using machine learning models on live sensor streams.
ideas.title: TelemetryGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Fits the software track perfectly by bringing advanced industrial anomaly detection techniques directly into aerospace telemetry operations.

ideas.pitch: A semantic routing framework optimized for querying complex aerospace engineering documentation and orbital mechanics guidelines using local embeddings.
ideas.title: AeroSim-Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates sophisticated software engineering and efficient LLM routing techniques that stand out among generic chatbot submissions.

ideas.pitch: An on-board computer vision and flight code reviewer running on constrained hardware NPUs to inspect rocket component imagery pre-launch.
ideas.title: FlightEdge-NPU
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages edge computing principles and hardware-software integration suitable for the hardware-adjacent judging criteria.

ideas.pitch: BPMN-orchestrated pre-flight safety checklist and risk diagnosis agent that coordinates multi-system readiness for small satellite launches.
ideas.title: AeroBPMN-Workflow
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings rigorous enterprise workflow governance to aerospace engineering checklists, impressing judges looking for structured execution.
